studies.title: At the Table
studies.subtitle: A six-session study for learning to follow Jesus in an ordinary room
studies.summary: Discipleship did not begin in a classroom. It began at tables, on roads, in borrowed rooms. This study is built for the same places: a living room, a kitchen table, a back booth. One person who has walked a little further opens the passage, and the people around the table read, talk, pray, and practice. By the last session, someone at the table is ready to set another one.
